correctness.rationale: Every witness is an exact equality of the same positive-definite norm. The displayed 8x10 matrix has an exact 8x8 determinant -608, so its kernel has complex dimension two, exhausted by constant and square vectors. Exhaustive classification of all collision groups for radii 3 through 9 gives rank 6 at radius 9 (nullity 3), and lower ranks for smaller radii; the explicit delta-at-five assignment gives a radius-9 nonquadratic witness. The algebraic norm identity with shifts 8,3,5 propagates the quadratic law inductively from the ten known values to every positive integer. Substitution characterizes F exactly on E4. The standalone code recomputes the integer determinant, rational ranks and norm identities, and passed on the actual package code path. No use of finite experiments as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The claim is framed around the SHARP minimal ten-coordinate finite collision cutoff, not around resolving the known nonlinear D=4 characterization. Kátai--Phong 2014 give a general additive-sumset criterion with an 8N-difference assumption inapplicable when A is 4 times squares; 2015 pose a broad sumset decomposition problem. You et al. 2016 exploit many of the same norm collisions in a nonlinear functional equation, even using index 11, but do not state or imply the rank deficiency at radius 9 or the exact minimal radius 10. Khanh 2017 Lemmas 1--2 supply quadratic-plus-periodic necessary form for an auxiliary linear equation, but not the ten-coordinate minimality comparison. Actual published-finding corpus semantic queries were checked, with no overlapping statement among the nearest records. Residual unindexed result risk remains.

value.rationale: The exact least truncation N=10 is a natural invariant of the first nontrivial coefficient-matched weighted square norm studied in functional-equation arithmetic: before it, norm collisions admit spurious nonquadratic functions, and from it, every infinite solution is forced to be affine in the squared input. The cutoff is sharp in a precise infinite-vs-finite sense, with explicit radius-nine obstruction, not a cosmetic or unmotivated numerical computation. The result makes the representation method quantitatively finite and separates arbitrary complex-linked decompositions from older nonlinear f classifications, without requiring a new general-D theorem.
